bio.text: Lauren Reinhold, a Democrat and Lawrence attorney, is a candidate for Kansas's 1st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She earned a law degree from the University of Kansas School of Law in 1996.
She worked for several years at the U.S. Social Security Administration in Kansas, first as an attorney and then as a human resources administrator, and her position was eliminated in 2025.
Before her federal roles she practiced immigration law in private practice.

sources.title: U.S. House candidate who lost job to DOGE campaigns on grassroots fundraising, rural Kansas issues
